lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\AdvertisingManager\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
